lines.zh: 迈着有力的步伐，雄狮巡视领地。
lines.en: With a powerful stride, the lion patrols its territory.
In the sunlight, the lion walks steadily.

lines.zh: 雄狮漫步在广阔的草原上。
lines.en: The lion strides across the vast savannah.

lines.zh: 低头觅食，雄狮巡视草丛。
lines.en: Lowering its head, the lion searches the grass.

lines.zh: 在阳光照射下，雄狮步伐矫健。
lines.en: Under the sun, the lion walks with grace.

lines.zh: 雄狮健步如飞，寻找猎物。
lines.en: The lion runs swiftly, searching for prey.

lines.zh: 雄狮缓缓走过长满青草的大地。
lines.en: The lion walks slowly over the green grassland.

lines.zh: 雄狮脚步轻盈，追逐猎物。
lines.en: The lion moves lightly, chasing prey.

lines.zh: 雄狮行走于茂密的草丛中。
lines.en: The lion walks through the dense grass.

lines.zh: 雄狮在草原上悠然行走。
lines.en: The lion walks leisurely on the savannah
My mane bounces with each step.

lines.zh: 雄狮懒洋洋地躺在阳光下。
lines.en: The lion lies lazily in the sun.

lines.zh: 阳光下，雄狮慵懒地躺着。
lines.en: In the sun, the lion lies lazily.

lines.zh: 雄狮舒展四肢，慵懒地晒太阳。
lines.en: The lion stretches, lazily basking in the sun.

lines.zh: 雄狮在树荫下悠闲地打盹。
lines.en: The lion dozes peacefully under a tree.

lines.zh: 雄狮晒着太阳，享受宁静。
lines.en: The lion enjoys the sun's warmth.

lines.zh: 雄狮躺在柔软的草地上，打起盹来。
lines.en: The lion lies down on the soft grass and dozes.

lines.zh: 雄狮在树荫下懒洋洋地睡觉。
lines.en: The lion lies lazily in the shade, sleeping.

lines.zh: 雄狮懒懒地在草地上打滚。
lines.en: The lion rolls lazily on the grass.

lines.zh: 雄狮慵懒地在阳光下打盹。
lines.en: The lion dozes lazily in the sun.

lines.zh: 雄狮躺在阳光下，享受片刻宁静。
lines.en: The lion lies in the sun, enjoying a moment of peace
My tail flicks away the flies.

lines.zh: 我用舌头理了理胸前的鬃毛。
lines.en: I smooth the mane on my chest with my tongue.
I lick the fur on my forepaw.
The wind flattens the grass; I squint.
The dry-season grass has gone yellow.

lines.zh: 我在等一群食草动物路过。
lines.en: I wait for a herd to pass.

lines.zh: 喉咙里发出低低的呼噜。
lines.en: A low rumble sits in my throat.
I lift my nose and taste the wind.
The lion stares at you, ready to attack.

lines.zh: 雄狮盯着你，准备随时攻击。
lines.en: The lion eyes you, ready to strike.

lines.zh: 雄狮注意到了你的靠近。
雄狮盯着你，准备跳跃攻击。
lines.en: The lion stares at you, ready to pounce.

lines.zh: 雄狮注意到了你的存在。
lines.en: The lion takes notice of you.

lines.zh: 雄狮盯着你，准备发动攻击。
lines.en: The lion watches you, ready to attack.

lines.zh: 雄狮盯紧你，随时准备扑击。
lines.en: The lion watches you, ready to pounce.

lines.zh: 雄狮注意到了你的威胁。
雄狮盯着你，准备进行攻击。
lines.en: The lion stares at you, ready to attack.

lines.zh: 我歪头，好像在打量你的骨头。
lines.en: I tilt my head, sizing up your bones.
Five steps closer is five too many.

lines.zh: 别想吃我，我要保护我的领地！
lines.en: Think you can eat me? I'll protect my territory.

lines.zh: 来吧，让我们共享这片草原吧。
lines.en: Come, share this savannah with me.

lines.zh: 你的食物够我一顿美餐了。
我的爪子比你想象的要利！
lines.en: My claws are sharper than you think.

lines.zh: 你这么靠近，我不介意尝尝。

lines.en: My roar can scare off enemies.

lines.zh: 享受你的美食，但别想逃跑。
lines.en: Enjoy your meal, but try not to run.

lines.zh: 你的味道不错，但不是我的。
lines.en: You taste good, but not mine.

lines.zh: 你站在我的草原路上了，鬃毛都竖了。
lines.en: You stand on my savanna path; even my mane bristles.

lines.zh: 别挡我的路，我心情不好。
你撞得太重了，我要生气了。
别再动了，小心我的爪子。
lines.en: Stop moving, or I'll use my claws.

lines.zh: 你撞到了我，我要教训你。
lines.en: You bumped me, now you'll learn.
Find a lion, mate with me.
Who wants to mate with me?
You want to mate? Pass my test.

lines.zh: 找我交配，别找其他狮子。
别找其他狮子，我是你的选择。
lines.en: Don't mate with others, I'm your choice.

lines.zh: 交配前，先看看我的样子。
lines.en: Look at me first before mating.
My mane is the brightest on the savanna.
I pick it up and drag it into the shade.

lines.zh: 这块肉，草原上的规矩归我。
lines.en: By savanna law, this meat is mine.

lines.zh: 草原上的风，带着你的汗味。
我的爪子已经陷进土里。
lines.en: My claws have already sunk into the soil.
I lower my forequarters, tail rigid.

lines.zh: 草原上的风，把味道送到我鼻前。
lines.en: Savanna wind brings the scent to my nose.

lines.zh: 准备好迎接我的攻击吧。
这片热带草原，归我的鬃毛。
lines.en: This savanna belongs to my mane.

lines.zh: 草原上的鬃毛一抖，就是要扑。
lines.en: A shake of my mane means the pounce.
The lion is fixed on you, do not move.

lines.zh: 草原的风，把气味送到我面前。
lines.en: The savanna wind carries your scent to me.
My hind legs coil for the leap.

lines.zh: 枯黄的草尖擦过我的腰。
lines.en: The dry grass tips brush my flank.

lines.zh: 一群狮子在远处跟着我。
lines.en: My pride trails me in the distance.

lines.zh: 炸开的土把我掀了个跟头。
lines.en: The blast throws me head over paws.

lines.zh: 箭插进肩胛，我甩了甩鬃毛。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my shoulder; I shake my mane.
Violet light scorches my mane; I growl.
